text: Professor, do you have a minute? I wanted to ask for your advice about something. Of course. What is it? I’m considering going to graduate school for German Studies and I wanted to know more about the graduate program that you went through. Sure, I can tell you a bit about it. I did my undergraduate degree in German and then I did my master’s and doctorate in German Studies. Interesting. What was the focus of your research? For my master’s, I focused on 20th century German literature and for my doctoral degree, I researched the role of women in 18th century Germany. That sounds really interesting! How long did it take you to finish your degrees? It took me about 6 years total. But it’s not all work - I had some great experiences living in Germany and traveling around Europe during my studies. That sounds amazing! Thank you so much for telling me about it!
